    41  uint16_t Tlv::GetSize(void) const
    42  {
    43      return IsExtended() ? sizeof(ExtendedTlv) + static_cast<const ExtendedTlv *>(this)->GetLength()
    44                          : sizeof(Tlv) + GetLength();
    45  }
    46
    47  uint8_t *Tlv::GetValue(void)
    48  {
    49      return reinterpret_cast<uint8_t *>(this) + (IsExtended() ? sizeof(ExtendedTlv) : sizeof(Tlv));
    50  }
    51
    52  const uint8_t *Tlv::GetValue(void) const
    53  {
    54      return reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(this) + (IsExtended() ? sizeof(ExtendedTlv) : sizeof(Tlv));
    55  }
    56
    57  otError Tlv::Get(const Message &aMessage, uint8_t aType, uint16_t aMaxSize, Tlv &aTlv)
    58  {
    59      otError  error;
    60      uint16_t offset;
    61      uint16_t size;
    62
    63      SuccessOrExit(error = Find(aMessage, aType, &offset, &size, NULL));
    64
    65      if (aMaxSize > size)
    66      {
    67          aMaxSize = size;
    68      }
    69
    70      aMessage.Read(offset, aMaxSize, &aTlv);
